summary: OpenAI and Oracle are partnering to let Oracle Cloud Infrastructure customers apply existing Oracle Universal Credits toward OpenAI models and Codex, with availability beginning in the coming weeks.

categories.reason: OpenAI models and Codex become purchasable through Oracle's cloud platform under existing commitments, making the platform relationship itself the subject of the announcement.
categories.quote: In the coming weeks, Oracle customers will be able to apply eligible Oracle Universal Credits toward OpenAI models and Codex through OCI.

practices.reason: Enterprises gain a new procurement path to access OpenAI models via existing Oracle purchasing workflows, which changes how a vendor relationship is set up but not the model or serving stack itself.
practices.quote: This gives customers a path to access OpenAI models under their existing purchasing workflow and cloud commitment.
